title: Identification and tissue-level validation of ferroptosis-related genes in small intestinal neuroendocrine neoplasms based on machine learning.
authors: Lv, Chuang; Liu, Zhiqiang; Tong, Chengcheng; Liu, Le; Dou, Ziyue; Chen, Xi
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于机器学习识别小肠神经内分泌肿瘤中的铁死亡相关基因，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Small intestinal neuroendocrine neoplasms (SI-NENs), a subgroup of neuroendocrine tumors originating from neuroendocrine cells in the small intestine, present significant therapeutic challenges, and their relationship with ferroptosis-a regulated form of cell death driven by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation-remains poorly understood. This study aimed to identify the ferroptosis-related genes in SI-NENs and evaluate their clinical relevance. METHODS: The RNA sequencing data of SI-NENs patients were retrieved from two public datasets (GSE65286 and GSE98894). Machine learning (LASSO regression, a regularization method for selecting key features by reducing redundant genes, and random forest, an ensemble learning algorithm that builds multiple decision trees to improve prediction accuracy) was adopted to identify the core ferroptosis-related genes in SI-NENs. An external cohort consisting of 10 health volunteers and 14 SI-NENs patients was enrolled and intestinal mucosal biopsies were obtained for validation. RESULTS: CDCA3, CDC25A, CYP4F8, and MYB were identified as the core ferroptosis-related genes in SI-NENs patients via machine learning. In the external cohort, immunofluorescence (IF) staining confirmed a significantly decreased expression of CYP4F8 and CDCA3 in patients with SI-NENs compared with the health control. Moreover, in G2/3 patients, the expression levels of CYP4F8 and CDCA3 were significantly decreased compared with G1 patients. In contrast, no significant difference in the expression of the four core ferroptosis genes was found across the different tumor locations, the age stratifications, or the abdominal pain statuses. In addition, a statically negative correlation of the expression of CYP4F8 was further detected concerning the tumor diameter and the expression of Ki67. CONCLUSION: Four core ferroptosis-related genes (CDCA3, CDC25A, CYP4F8, and MYB) were identified in SI-NENs patients, which may aid in developing the diagnostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets in the clinic.
abstract_zh: 背景：小肠神经内分泌肿瘤（SI-NENs）是起源于小肠神经内分泌细胞的神经内分泌肿瘤亚群，其治疗面临重大挑战，且其与铁死亡（ferroptosis）——一种由铁依赖性脂质过氧化驱动的调节性细胞死亡形式——之间的关系仍知之甚少。本研究旨在识别SI-NENs中的铁死亡相关基因，并评估其临床相关性。方法：从两个公共数据集（GSE65286和GSE98894）中获取SI-NENs患者的RNA测序数据。采用机器学习（LASSO回归，一种通过减少冗余基因来选择关键特征的正则化方法，以及随机森林，一种构建多个决策树以提高预测准确性的集成学习算法）来识别SI-NENs中的核心铁死亡相关基因。纳入一个由10名健康志愿者和14名SI-NENs患者组成的外部队列，并获取肠黏膜活检样本进行验证。结果：通过机器学习，CDCA3、CDC25A、CYP4F8和MYB被确定为SI-NENs患者中的核心铁死亡相关基因。在外部队列中，免疫荧光（IF）染色证实，与健康对照相比，SI-NENs患者中CYP4F8和CDCA3的表达显著降低。此外，在G2/3期患者中，CYP4F8和CDCA3的表达水平较G1期患者显著下降。相比之下，四个核心铁死亡基因的表达在不同肿瘤位置、年龄分层或腹痛状态之间未发现显著差异。另外，进一步检测到CYP4F8的表达与肿瘤直径及Ki67表达呈统计学负相关。结论：在SI-NENs患者中识别出四个核心铁死亡相关基因（CDCA3、CDC25A、CYP4F8和MYB），这可能有助于临床开发诊断生物标志物和治疗靶点。
